description: JDW Sugar Mills Limited's principal activity is the production and sale of crystalline sugar, carried out through three sugar mills - JDW Unit-I and Unit-II in District Rahim Yar Khan and Unit-III in District Ghotki, Sindh - together with Deharki Sugar Mills (Pvt.) Limited, which the company describes as its subsidiary. It also runs high-pressure co-generation plants at Unit-II (26.6 MW) and Unit-III (26.8 MW) and manages sugarcane corporate farms over 26,380 acres in Punjab and Sindh.
sourceNote: Written from: jdw-group.com (home), jdw-group.com/ProfileOfCompany, jdw-group.com/Segments/Sugar, jdw-group.com/Governance/BoardofDirectors (Chief Executive Officer), jdw-group.com/Contact-Us (head office telephone) (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Crystalline sugar

products.name: Electricity from co-generation
products.summary: Two high-pressure co-generation plants - 26.6 MW at Unit-II (Sadiqabad) and 26.8 MW at Unit-III (Ghotki) - commissioned in 2014.

products.name: Corporate farming
